reviews.text:
Klaudia is a fairy, conscientious and very patient.
Our little bison dog also tolerated cosmetics much better than her. She looked beautiful and wasn't so afraid.
After all, it matters a lot how the beautician relates to their work, whether they just enjoy it because they have to, or they love it.

We were at Kitti's in Sugár..... we will stay again... 😀
We came on a recommendation and it was really 10/10.
Thank you for the Jutiwallis and the cuteness.
Dobi 🐶 & Fati 🙋‍♀️ …

We visited Klaudia today..she quickly understood our difficult puppy, we got a super fragrant and beautifully trimmed puppy back in just over an hour. This was the first time a shelter puppy went to a groomer. We will only go here. I can only recommend it.

We visited Klaudia. We are very satisfied. She treated my agile and excitable dog perfectly, who waited for us back neatly and happily. It was obvious that she had a good time with her new friend

She also handled the delay due to our train flexibly and helpfully.

We received a correct service at a good price. Thank you!

Thank you to Klaudia for cutting Zizi's nails in 5 minutes, we couldn't handle it. She also helped her ego a bit, Zizi has never been so calm 😁
Professional and very kind to both the dog and the owner! …
I regularly bring my Pom here and I am completely satisfied. Kitti professionally takes care of my dog's coat. Thank you!
Animal lover, kind beauticians, pleasant environment! :-)
We love going here with Luna!!🙂 …
I highly recommend it, I am very satisfied!! 😊 …
